title: Tiorpat Tornwing
summary: Tiorpat calls members of the surrounding crowd into combat.
overview: Tiorpat calls members of the surrounding crowd into combat.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Clear space and identify the surrounding dragorn before starting the confrontation.
Expect repeated calls for help while Tiorpat fights.
Collect newly hostile supporters promptly and keep them away from healers.
A prolonged disengagement can reset the gathering.
